description: Jest's default `transformIgnorePatterns` (`/node_modules/` and `\\.pnp\\.[^\\/]+$`) ignore `esm-pkg`, ES module source with no `type`, so Jest 30.5.2 runs it untransformed as CommonJS: the `import` is a `SyntaxError`, which `CjsLoader` (no `--experimental-vm-modules`, so no synchronous ES module evaluation) turns into its `ERR_REQUIRE_ESM` error, `Must use import to load ES Module: <path>` and the three ways out, and the test file fails to run (exit 1). The transform is the recorder's, widened to `.js` by `jestTransformJs`, so only the patterns keep the package out. Read by `provino`'s `transform-node-modules.test.ts` and by the policy claim for `module.messages.require-esm`. A black-box run.
